title: Clarifying External Users for a team

question.author: member_080
question.body: Before I explain external users to my team, what should I verify in the official guide?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Sharing Files and Folders documentation says: External users with Edit permission on a folder can upload files to it — their uploads count against the folder owner's quota. You can convert an external user into a guest account from the Sharing settings of the folder. People outside your organization do not need a CloudBox account to access a share link. Anonymous visitors can view and download; to edit or comment they must enter a name (and optionally sign in). That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
